title: [Sm6O4(cbz)10(thf)6]·2C7H8. A Polynuclear Samarium Oxo Cluster Obtained from Carbazole-Driven Oxidation of Samarium Nanoparticles

material_class.structural_family: Sm6O4 oxo cluster with carbazolate and THF ligands

synthesis.procedure: All operations were performed under argon using Schlenk techniques or glove boxes. Sm(0) nanoparticles were first prepared by dissolving 137.1 mg SmI2(thf)2 (0.25 mmol) in 10 mL THF and injecting a [LiNaph] solution made from 3.5 mg Li (0.5 mmol) and 67.3 mg naphthalene (0.525 mmol) in 5 mL THF (12 h dissolution); stirring used glass rods. Immediate formation of a deep black suspension indicated Sm(0) nanoparticles, which were isolated by centrifugation (25000 U min−1, 55200 g), washed by resuspension/centrifugation in THF or toluene, and redispersed in 15 mL THF. Carbazole (83.6 mg, 0.5 mmol) was added and the suspension was warmed to 50 °C for 12 h, giving a pale yellow solid that was centrifuged and washed with THF. The THF-insoluble intermediate (estimated as [Sm6O4(cbz)10(thf)6]·2C12H9N, ~90% yield) was dispersed and recrystallized from 1 mL toluene. After 5 weeks at room temperature, pale yellow, mechanically fragile rod-like single crystals of [Sm6O4(cbz)10(thf)6]·2C7H8 were obtained (~10% yield).

reagents.name: Sm(0) nanoparticles
reagents.amount: prepared from 0.25 mmol SmI2(thf)2, redispersed in 15 mL THF

synthesis.temperature: 50 °C for oxidation; room temperature (~25 °C) for crystallization
synthesis.time: 12 h oxidation; 5 weeks (also reported as 4–5 weeks) crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/glove-box inert-atmosphere synthesis; centrifugation isolation; recrystallization from toluene
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pale yellow solid after 50 °C reaction was separated by centrifugation, washed by repeated resuspension/centrifugation in THF, then dispersed and recrystallized from 1 mL toluene to give pale yellow rod-like single crystals.
